events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has significant implications for global geopolitics and oil prices. The conflict may lead to increased tensions in the Middle East and affect the global economy. Oil prices may rise due to supply chain disruptions.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The Iran war may lead to increased volatility in the stock market, and the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) may be a good buy due to its diversified portfolio. On the other hand, the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) may be a good short due to the potential decline in oil prices.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust the position as needed

events.exitStrategy: Exit the position if the conflict escalates further or if the oil prices rise significantly
